pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. One complete small round tabletop alarm clock with plain white face, blue casing, two feet and two metal bells on top. The LONG THICK MINUTE HAND is BRIGHT RED and points vertically UP nearly to the tick ring; the SHORTER HOUR hand is dark gray and points horizontally left. One small RED arrow from outside the clock points precisely to the LONG RED MINUTE HAND near its upper tip, identifying MINUTE. Clock face has simple black tick marks only, NO digits, roman numerals, letters, branding or labels. Clearly different hand lengths, one center pivot, exactly two clock hands, no second hand. Red indicator arrow is clearly separate from the clock hands. Clean minimal object-only composition on white, full clock and arrow with generous margins. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
